seoTitle: Unsupported robots.txt Directives: Noindex, Host, Crawl-delay
metaDescription: Find robots.txt lines Google ignores, such as Noindex, Nofollow, Host, Clean-param and Crawl-delay, with what to use instead. Free.
intro: Lists lines that Google does not use and suggests the working alternative for each.
why:
Old advice put Noindex, Nofollow and Host lines into robots.txt. Google supports only user-agent, allow, disallow and sitemap, so these lines do nothing there. Google stopped honouring Noindex in robots.txt in 2019.

The tool shows each unsupported line with its number and the usual replacement. Other search engines may read some of them; that is not checked here.
howTo: Read the list of ignored lines.
Replace them with the suggested method.

faq.a: For Google, yes. Use a robots meta tag or an X-Robots-Tag header.
Google ignores it. Keep it only if another crawler you care about reads it.
